summary: demo-workshop.mp4 (1440x900 h264 38.61s, 7 beat clips / 7 scene segments + end card, Kokoro af_heart 0.9) produced end-to-end via the piano-demo-video pipeline for the Workshop and published to both spots with identical md5. Capture was signed-out (Workshop, block library, and /marketplace are public routes) — no Clerk setup needed; each shot is a self-contained fresh context replaying its own state (fresh store seeds the starter page + template picker). One product bug shaped the beat plan: on main, useDrillRuntime never calls useDrillTimer's arm(), so a Workshop drill timer sticks at 'Play when ready' forever and scoring never runs (fix exists on unmerged branch claude/drill-arm-and-keyboard-audio, 31318a3). Since app source is out of scope, the play beat was re-anchored to behavior that genuinely works on main: the metronome block pulsing on the grid, and the marketplace-fork page's on-screen keyboard lighting up while playing Cmaj7 (verified numerically: keyboard-band YAVG 37.33 -> 39.26 during key hold). One capture defect was caught and fixed before render: the first edit-grid take's pressSequentially appended to the existing title ('First chordsMorning warmup'); re-shot with fill('') first.

tooling_notes: Same screencast lag (~1.5-2.5s) and ffmpeg -ss-past-EOF repeats-last-frame behaviors as prior phases — kept all OCR samples inside take duration. New tooling notes: (1) tesseract on the caption strip is position/scale-sensitive over busy UI — crop=1200:64:120:804 scaled 2x with psm 11 works for most chunks; a gray-threshold pass (format=gray,geq=lum>200) recovers chunks sitting on light card backgrounds; single-sample OCR misses are NOT missing captions. (2) ffmpeg signalstats metadata=print logs at info level: -v error suppresses it entirely — use -hide_banner without -v error. (3) The Workshop drill-runtime bug (no arm() call) means the timer block's Start leads to a permanent 'Play when ready' on main; any future workshop demo beat that shows scoring needs the claude/drill-arm-and-keyboard-audio branch merged first. (4) pressSequentially appends to existing input text — clear with fill('') first when renaming the page title on camera.
handoff_notes: This closes the demo-videos run: every ready-made drill plus the Workshop now has a demo video.
